description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of video categories within a dataset. The chart contains 13 slices, each representing a different video category. The categories and their approximate proportions are as follows: People/Blogs at 17.2%, Entertainment at 13.9%, Education at 8.7%, Howto/Style at 9.7%, Film/Animation at 7.7%, Sports at 6.4%, Gaming at 4.6%, Travel/Events at 5.6%, Comedy at 6.6%, Science/Technology at 4.3%, News/Politics at 3.9%, Autos/Vehicles at 4.8%, and Pets/Animals at 2.3%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained throughout. A legend is not present, as the category labels are directly adjacent to their corresponding slices. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
